definition: the part of a camera with glass that you point at what you photograph
description: A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.
transcript: Perfect. Sharp. Got it. Amazing! Yes!
